settings.closed_closed: Laplace pole series, brentq roots, 800 terms
settings.curve_fit: scipy.optimize.curve_fit method=lm, xtol=ftol=gtol=1e-14, p0 = 1.2 tau, 1.3 p
settings.tail: scipy.stats.linregress on ln C over the last 25 % of samples; quad for the tail integrals

header.notes: t in s, E in 1/s, C = C_scale * E (arbitrary unit). exact_mean/exact_variance are those of the untruncated distribution (open-open: mean tau(1+2/Pe), var tau^2(2/Pe+8/Pe^2), confirmed by quad; closed-closed by quad of the series). ref_moments are computed on the truncated sampled record. cc records start at 0.02 tau.
